_comment: TEACHER: copy this to setup.local.json, fill it in, and ship it inside the
pre-cloned repo folder you hand each student. setup.local.json is gitignored,
so the token never lands in the repo.
The token should be a FINE-GRAINED personal access token with Contents:
read+write on THIS ONE REPO ONLY. It is shared across the class, which is
fine for a trusted group — REVOKE IT WHEN THE COURSE ENDS.
Never use a broad or personal-account-wide token here.
